name: Chao bo
summary: Beef porridge. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says the broth is beef bone, with scallion and sawtooth, and that the bowl is full of tendon, bone, and beef offal. It names gỏi bò as the plate beside it.
origin: Quy Nhon. The provincial portal addresses the bowl to the city.
taste: The portal says the broth is rich, fragrant, and slightly hot from the herbs.
howToEat: Order the porridge. The same page names gỏi bò as the pairing and does not describe that salad.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The address field is Quy Nhon. A street was not printed.
seoTitle: Chao bo — Quy Nhon beef porridge
seoDescription: Quy Nhon cháo bò is beef-bone porridge with tendon, bone, and offal. The provincial portal names gỏi bò beside it and does not describe the salad. Check on arrival.
